headline_grade: AAA including Maths (or AABB with fourth A level)
epq_reduction: A in EPQ may reduce offer by up to one grade
additional_conditions: If studying towards a fourth A level, an alternative offer of AABB including Mathematics may be made.
document_text: York A level entry requires AAA including Mathematics. If studying towards a fourth A level, York will make an alternative offer of AABB including Mathematics.

subject_required: Significant portion of Maths equivalent to A level standard
additional_conditions: Syllabus must contain a significant portion of Mathematics equivalent to A level standard. Contact Department before applying.
document_text: York accepts the Access to Higher Education Diploma. The syllabus must contain a significant portion of Mathematics considered equivalent to A level standard. Applications are considered on an individual basis - contact the Department before applying.

headline_grade: DDD plus grade B in A level Maths
subject_required: A level Mathematics required alongside BTEC
additional_conditions: Various BTEC combinations accepted: DD in BTEC National Diploma plus A in A level Maths; Distinction in BTEC Extended Certificate plus AA at A level including Maths; DD in 2 BTEC Extended Certificates plus A in A level Maths.
document_text: York BTEC National Extended Diploma entry requires DDD plus grade B in A level Mathematics. York considers a range of BTEC combinations equivalent to 3 A levels or in combination with A levels: Distinction Distinction in BTEC National Diploma plus A in A level Maths; Distinction in BTEC National Extended Certificate plus AA at A level including Maths; or Distinction Distinction in 2 BTEC National Extended Certificates plus A in A level Mathematics.
York European Baccalaureate entry requires 85% overall including 85% in Mathematics.

subject_required: HL Maths grade 5, or SL Maths grade 6
additional_conditions: 5 in HL Maths (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations), OR 6 in SL Maths (Analysis and Approaches).
document_text: York IB entry requires 36 points overall including 5 in Higher Level Mathematics (either Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations), or 6 in Standard Level Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches).

headline_grade: Not accepted unless additional A level Maths taken
additional_conditions: T levels not accepted for this course unless an additional A level (or equivalent) in Mathematics has been taken.
document_text: York is currently not accepting T levels for the Computer Science course unless an additional A level (or equivalent qualification) in Mathematics has been taken alongside the T level.

headline_grade: Advanced Higher A in Maths + Highers BBBB
additional_conditions: May also consider three Advanced Highers or a combination of Highers and Advanced Highers where grade not met through Highers alone. Contact to discuss.
document_text: York Scottish entry requires Advanced Higher grade A in Mathematics plus Scottish Highers BBBB. York may also consider three Advanced Highers or a combination of Highers and Advanced Highers where an applicant does not meet the grade requirement through Highers alone - contact York to discuss.

headline_grade: Up to 2 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: Must have attended UK state-funded school and pay UK Home fees. Based on postcode data or refugee/humanitarian protection status. Subject requirements (Maths) still apply. Applied automatically via UCAS.
document_text: York contextual offer provides up to 2 grades below the standard offer. For example, instead of AAA, York might ask for ABB (not including subject-specific requirements). Eligibility is based on postcode data from UCAS, or holding refugee or humanitarian protection status. Students must have attended a UK state-funded school, college or sixth form and pay UK Home fees. Assessed automatically when the application is received. Subject-specific requirements such as Mathematics still apply.

headline_grade: Up to 2 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: For students with care experience or estranged from family. Must notify York directly via Additional Information Form. Dedicated support for independent students provided.
document_text: York offers up to 2 grades below the standard offer for students with experience of being in the care of their local authority, or who are estranged from their family. Students must notify York directly. York also provides dedicated contact and support for independent students.

headline_grade: Up to 3 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: Must complete an Access & Outreach programme: Next Step York, Black Access, or Realising Opportunities. Stacks with standard or contextual offer. Contact programme team.
document_text: York Access and Outreach alternative offer provides up to 3 grades below the standard offer for students who successfully complete a programme such as Next Step York, Black Access, or Realising Opportunities and meet any subject criteria. Students receive a standard or contextual offer plus this alternative offer. For CS specifically, widening participation gives BBB including Mathematics conditional on completing the WP programme including the YorJourney module or Realising Opportunities.

epq_reduction: A in EPQ = up to one grade below typical offer
additional_conditions: CS-specific alternative offers: Contextual offer ABB including Maths; Widening participation BBB including Maths (conditional on WP programme); EPQ grade A gives one grade reduction.
document_text: York Computer Science specific alternative offers are: Contextual offer of ABB including Mathematics; Widening participation offer of BBB including Mathematics conditional on completing the WP programme including the YorJourney module (Black Access Programme, Next Step York) or Realising Opportunities; and an EPQ alternative offer up to one A level grade below the typical offer if grade A or higher is achieved in the EPQ.
